_comment: Advisory exceptions for this Cargo workspace (RightKit class A policy, as ci/advisory-exceptions.json in RightKit). deny.toml and .cargo/audit.toml must match it exactly; approvedBy needs a person.

exceptions.rationale: glib arrives only through tauri's Linux/BSD-gated GTK dependency (tao, wry, webkit2gtk); the Tauri desktop release targets are Windows and macOS only. Invalidated the moment any GTK (Linux or BSD) Tauri target ships.
exceptions.evidence: deny.toml [advisories].ignore reason; Cargo.lock reverse dependencies of glib

exceptions.rationale: tauri-plugin-updater 2.14.0 (the latest) requires zip ^4 as an optional Windows-only dependency; the updater installs only bytes returned by its minisign-verified download, so no unsigned archive is ever extracted.
exceptions.evidence: deny.toml [advisories].ignore reason; Cargo.lock reverse dependencies of zip
